title: 2011 AMC 10B Problem 3
statement: At a store, when a length is reported as \(x\) inches that means it is at least \(x - 0.5\) inches and at most \(x + 0.5\) inches. Suppose the dimensions of a rectangular tile are reported as \(2\) inches by \(3\) inches. In square inches, what is the minimum area for the rectangle?

solutions.text:
The smallest possible dimensions are \(1.5\times 2.5,\) so the area is \[1.5\cdot 2.5=3.75.\]

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Use the smallest possible length and width
The reported \(2\) by \(3\) tile can be as small as \(1.5\) by \(2.5\)
